$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFMT (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

notes: AD prohibited for ULM (except based) and gliders except in case of emergency.

Use of RWY 12R/30L prohibited for ACFT complying with at least one of the following conditions: Weight over 5.7 t,; Turbojet,; Wingspan over 24 m,; Main gear overall width over 6 m,; Reference TKOF distance over 800 m.
TWY L1, L2, K, Q, R and S prohibited for ACFT whose weight is over 5.7 t.
A special care shall be paid to the misleading visual effects of the coastline which is not perpendicular to the RWY axes.
AD likely to be obscured by sea fog in a few minutes.
AD located in an IBA (Important Bird Area).
A lot of birds on AD and vicinity: danger of bats and flocks of birds (day and night).
Risk of turbulence on RWY 12R / 30L with a strong SW wind.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Beware taxiing at the intersection of TWY L1, L2 and S1: arrival/departure crossing area from parkings ENAC, ESMA and ACB.
Special precaution is required during crossing on the marking and signage.
Maximum wingspan for crossing at the intersection: 13,45 m (Cessna 425).
AVGAS 100LL automatique dispenser to be used only by ACFT whose wingspan is less than 12 m.
Preferred QFU: 303° due to IFR procedure.
Arrival Procedures First contact must be established at least 3 minutes before overflying entry points, awaiting clearance.

Except clearance or special instruction, overfly entry points in compliance with altitudes indicated below: Maximum altitudes Frequency to contact Departures procedures Respect the direction of turn of aerodrome circuit.
Possible exemption with control clearance.
Transit Procedures The published transits on VAC chart are likely to be enforced by ATC, in particular the SW-ES transit at 1000 ft when VIS > 4500 m.
Users are reminded of their responsibility for carrying life jackets for any maritime overflight.
An intense activity of general aviation and training flights is observed around the airport.
RWY configuration "facing north" - RWY 30R & 30L - shall be preferred for environmental reasons.
Further details are provided below about trajectories and training flights.
Training flights Special measures apply to based aircraft.
Prior approval must be granted by the aerodrome operator and the air navigation service for training of any aircraft which is not based at Montpellier Méditerranée Airport.
A training guide document is available on the airport's website.
Demand shall be sent at least 48h before (business days) to the following email and must include aircraft type, registration, date, duration and nature of the training.

Please specify any parking stand, handling or refueling request. montpellier-subdivision-ctl@aviation-civile.gouv.fr Circuits around the airfield (traffic patterns, IFR APP, engine failure and go around simulations…) are: prohibited for aircrafts of acoustic groups 1,2 and 3;; allowed for aircraft of acoustic groups 4 and 5 from 1st.
October to 15 june included, from MON to SAT except public HOL, from 0700 to 2000 (SUM - 1 HR), allowed all year long for piston engine ACFT from 0700 to 2000 (SUM - 1 HR).

Additional slot restrictions apply on secondary RWY 12R/30L, from June 21st to September 21st, on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays for training flights: avoid traffic patterns between 12h00 and 15h00 local time,; avoid traffic patterns between 15h00 and 17h00 local time except for low noise emissions ACFT (CALIPSO.
Secondary RWY pattern 12R / 30L On RWY 12R/30L, circuit patterns are flown in the South-West of the RWY and at a minimum altitude of 1000 ft.
Circuit patterns on secondary runway are forbidden to any ACFT which is not Montpellier-based when RWY 12R is in use.
When RWY 30L is active, departing ACFT shall follow heading 283° after take off, unless otherwise instructed by ATC.
When RWY 12R is active, departing ACFT going westbound should avoid city of Perols, in order to fly vertically over the Rhône canal at Sète.
Caution during last turn for final approach, in order not to interfere with main RWY 12L / 30R axis.
For all ACFT, landing lights are recommended on final.
Main RWY pattern 12L / 30R On RWY 12L/30R, circuit patterns are flown in the NorthEast of the RWY.
In traffic pattern RWY 12L, ACFT must maintain a minimum altitude of 1000 ft in downwind leg.
Aircraft shall preferably avoid overflying cities of Mauguio and La Grande Motte, unless otherwise instructed by ATC.
RWY 30R, when taking off for a training pattern, it is mandatory for the initial turn to be performed at 1,4 NM FJR to join right hand downing leg.
The circuit must not go beyond A9 highway except otherwise instructed by ATC.
VIS 1500 m.
Night VFR routes: See AIP ENR 3.3 § 5.3.6 MONTPELLIER and ENR 3.3 LFMM SOUTH ITI NIGHT VFR chart.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with secondary surveillance radar (see AD 1.0).

RADIO FAILURE special instructions Upon arrival: Squawk A7600; Outside the CTR: do not enter; Inside the CTR:; before receiving clearance to enter the runway circuit: exit the CTR by the most appropriate VFR route without crossing the runway axis.; after receiving clearance to enter the runway circuit: enter the circuit as authorized, then land, and clear at the end of the runway.
Wait then follow the vehicle "follow me".

On departure: Before entering the runway: do not take off, wait and follow the "follow me" vehicle.; Before takeoff after penetration: clear the runway at the first exit, wait and then follow the vehicle "follow me".; After takeoff: squawk A7600.
Respect last clearance until leaving controlled airspace.
In transit: Before receiving clearance to enter the controlled airspace: do not enter it.; In controlled airspace: leave the controlled airspace.
In CTR, do not cross the runway axis.
Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: Continu pendant la journée aéronautique / Continuous during the aeronautical day.
